title: Quietly Earthy Argentinian Hazelnuts Tagine
description: A rich and earthy ovo-vegetarian dish from Argentina, cooked in a tagine and featuring hazelnuts, this recipe is perfect for a rainy day. The combination of flavors and textures will transport you to the monsoon season in Argentina.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped hazelnuts and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Crack the eggs into the tagine and cook, covered, for an additional 10 minutes, until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped hazelnuts if desired.
